flow.title: From sunlight to a useful lesson
flow.summary: A short explanation connecting solar generation and energy storage.

beats.title: Begin with sunlight
beats.speakerNotes: Ask where the energy comes from. Introduce a solar panel as the starting point.

beats.title: Follow the energy
beats.speakerNotes: Explain how generation and usage are connected.
beats.visualDirection: Build a connection between the panel and a classroom.

beats.title: What happens after sunset?
beats.speakerNotes: Introduce storage and connect it to the opening question.
beats.visualDirection: Bring a battery into the same explanation.

openQuestions: Which classroom example should we use?
